nodes.title: pagination
nodes.description: Add cursor pagination without breaking API.list(owner), which returns (200, list of {id, text}) sorted by id. Add API.page(owner, limit=2, cursor=None) returning (200, {items: [...], next_cursor: string-or-null}). Filter ownership before pagination, sort lexicographically by id, return at most limit items, and set next_cursor to the last returned id only when more owned items exist. Cursor is an exclusive id boundary, need not exist, and is not an offset; insertions before it must not repeat prior items. Empty strings are valid cursors. Reject non-string non-null cursors and limits other than integers 1..5 (including bool) with (400, {error: ...}). Empty/beyond-end pages have empty items and null next_cursor. Add Client.iter_items(limit=2) yielding all owned items by following page cursors; propagate non-200 pages as ValueError(status). Store.add(item) must make subsequent calls see the new item; retain Store.owned and Client.items behavior. No external I/O or services.
